title: Recovered 'relic' tech brought in by security team for telepathic study
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: it'd be like eight security personnel and a huge box, you know, and then I would be in the room with a team of people watching me

plain: Jordan Jose says that as a child, around 2008 to 2010, he was taken into a secret UFO programme at a place called Baker Victory Services in Western New York. He told podcast host Jesse Michels that about eight security guards would bring in a huge box holding what he calls a relic, a recovered piece of technology, while a team watched him in the room to study his telepathic abilities. He mentions a man named Jacob Barber in connection with the story.
